claims.head: Toronto’s chances off turnovers meet a soft spot
claims.body: Toronto ranks 1st of 32 for chances off turnovers (8.4% of its chances come right after winning the puck); Buffalo ranks 22nd of 32 for avoiding breakdowns.

check.measure: share of 5-on-5 expected goals within 5 seconds of winning the puck
check.rule: held if tonight's figure is at or above the team's usual level; partly if between the league average and that level; otherwise didn't happen

claims.head: Opposite ends on shot suppression
claims.body: Buffalo ranks 6th of 32 for shot suppression, toward the stingy end; Toronto ranks 28th, toward the porous end.
